title: Clay-Style 3D — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: The idea lands
scenes.purpose: Establish the dark slate studio sweep and the clay idea bulb with weight: it drops, squashes on contact and rebounds elastically.
visuals: Seamless dark slate-green cyclorama with a soft overhead light pool and a stationary vignette
Peach clay head (#C7917B) on an ink socket (#3E4A46) with two sage grooves (#93AD9E) and a pressed-in brow arc
Soft contact shadow that tightens and darkens as the bulb reaches the floor
assets: clay-scene.bundle.js (procedural Three.js scene, bundled from src/clay-scene.js)

beats.development: The bulb falls from above the frame into the light pool, slightly stretched while falling.
Contact: volume-preserving squash, then a damped elastic rebound. The title starts rising in.

scenes.title: Connections extrude
scenes.purpose: Show the idea becoming a system: clay tubes extrude from the bulb, and clay orbs drop in to meet each tube and form the network.
visuals: Five clay tubes grow along XPBD-baked rope paths that sag and drape onto the floor
Three sage orbs and one peach orb drop in, squash and settle at the tube ends
Two orb-to-orb tubes close the loop to the far-right orb

beats.development: Tubes extrude toward the front, back and middle orbs, which land in sequence at 1.08, 1.26 and 1.42 s. Both title lines are settled by 1.2 s.
Orb-to-orb tubes grow toward the far-right orb, which drops in at 1.95 s. The landing tugs the ropes and the XPBD solver absorbs it.

scenes.title: Settled system
scenes.purpose: Let the connected clay network settle and hold as a readable lockup.
visuals: Last orb squash decays and the tubes come to rest on the floor
Footer fades in at the lower right

beats.development: The final squash decays, the rope wobble damps out and the footer fades in.
Full lockup holds still: bulb, network, title, subtitle and footer, all legible.

findings: The bulb drop takes 0.42 s and its squash settles in about 0.4 s, which gives the clay weight without lingering.
Tube and orb arrivals are staggered by 0.16–0.5 s so that each connection can be followed along the eye path from left to right.
Copy appears only after the bulb lands, so the falling object never crosses visible text.
Rope motion falls below about 0.01 scene units per frame by 2.67 s, and every element is settled by 2.7 s.
justifiedHolds: 2.35–3.0 s: a final still lockup gives a settled reading hold for all three lines of copy.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects, voice or lyrics.
This is a clay-like 3D treatment rendered procedurally in Three.js WebGL. No physical clay was filmed.
Planned Blender/Cycles route was blocked: Blender 5.2.2 crashes at startup in this sandbox during Metal GPU backend detection.
Background is a scene-dependent dark slate-green studio sweep, which replaces the earlier warm cream canvas. It follows the reviewed hero/stage/accent luminance structure.
